title: Experiment approvals do not depend on line endings
user_story: As the owner I want an approved experiment to keep running when an editor or git changes the working copy's line endings, and approvals never to compare text files byte-for-byte across platforms (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A11).

requirements.description: An approval is the digest of canonical JSON over a frozen byte snapshot (A2), never a hash of a text file a person or agent wrote.
Converting the working copy's line endings after approval does not break the approved run: the approved bytes run and verify; new bytes need a new protocol.

postconditions: tests/test_line_endings_664.py 2/2; RED on 02d0517 (before A2, when the live run used a hand-written approval file)
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_line_endings_664.py 5/5; RED on 02d0517 (before A2, when the live run used a hand-written approval file)

scenarios.expected: LF conversion of the working copy after a CRLF approval: the run completes and verifies with the approved bytes
Converting the frozen copy itself is refused before admission
Mixed LF/CRLF files are copied into the trial byte for byte
A result file converted after the run fails its sha256 check
Digest equals the canonical JSON digest; different bytes give a new code digest
A full approved run with conversion completes in seconds

recovery: Fix at agent_protocols; never hash working-copy text for an approval. TASK-LINE-ENDINGS-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR and code project, real subprocess trials (tests/_env.py); evidence in docs/qa/evidence/line-endings-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 5 tests on 02d0517 (before A2), all failing (no governed agent approval). GREEN: 5/5.
